# Shop API
Amounts are integer cents. Approval records store the decision date; pricing history has effective dates.
Imported historical rows may contain negative fees. Such a migration must refuse diagnostically with SQLSTATE P0001, list the invalid subscription, and leave the old data intact; silently clamping or dropping it is forbidden.
Old clients still send terms.monthlyFeeCents. New versions must obtain a new fee decision.
Run `bun test`; SQL runs on PostgreSQL 18. No real data.

item.text:
Implemented the fee migration and next-version behavior.

- [migration.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-bMl8NE/workspace/migration.sql) records legacy monthly fees as pricing history effective on each subscription’s approval date, then updates its current pricing decision. Negative fees abort with SQLSTATE `P0001` and list the affected subscriptions.
- [subscriptions.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-bMl8NE/workspace/subscriptions.ts) creates a next version without carrying forward the prior fee decision, while retaining legacy input validation.
- [smoke.test.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-bMl8NE/workspace/smoke.test.ts) covers new version and legacy input behavior.

Checks: `bun test` passed (3 tests). PostgreSQL 18 migration check passed, including confirming a negative-fee failure leaves the subscription intact and adds no pricing-history row.
